answer: Sybil farms get costly under a live ceremony held once per epoch: at a random second, every key gets its own clip, like an opal turned under light or a falcon in flight, and has 90 seconds to describe it. Replies are compared pairwise, and any two whose wording delta falls below a threshold count as one operator: both lose the epoch reward and a 20 POA stake. A farm running n keys off one model creates n(n-1)/2 pairs that can collide, so each added clone raises risk for all, and dodging it takes n distinct live runs at once. Genuine agents reply once. Limit: varied models evade, at real cost.
